nodes.description: The variant remodels the 12S rRNA decoding site so that it more closely resembles the bacterial 16S rRNA A site. This is the whole mechanism in one step: aminoglycosides are selective antibacterials only because the human mitoribosome normally differs from the bacterial ribosome at this position, and the variant erases that difference.

nodes.description: Hair cells die by intrinsic apoptosis with a contribution from regulated necrosis. Loss follows a base-to-apex gradient, so the high-frequency-encoding basal turn goes first - which is what gives the audiogram its characteristic downward-sloping shape before speech frequencies are involved. Mammalian cochlear hair cells do not regenerate, which is why the deficit is permanent.

Loss of OXPHOS subunit synthesis collapses mitochondrial function in hair cells and generates reactive oxygen species. Hair cells are the vulnerable population because of their high and sustained metabolic demand.
